message: Under the old regime the deductions claimed u/s 80C, 80CCC and 80CCD(1) together ({{claimed}}) cannot exceed {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the combined claim to {{limit}} or lower.

remediation: Reduce the 80CCD(1) claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: If Old Tax is selected and employer category is "CG-Pensioners" "SG-Pensioners" "PSU-Pensioners" "Other Pensioners" or Not Applicable, then Deduction u/s 80CCD (1) should not be more than 20% of Gross total Income

message: The deduction u/s 80CCD(1) of {{claimed}} cannot exceed 10% of salary u/s 17(1) ({{limit}}) for this employment category.
remediation: Reduce the 80CCD(1) claim to {{limit}} or lower.

appliesWhen: isOldRegime and not inList(employerCategory, K.chapterVIA.s80CCD2.oldRegime.govtCategories) and not inList(employerCategory, K.chapterVIA.s80CCD2.blockedCategories)
message: Under the old regime the deduction u/s 80CCD(2) of {{claimed}} cannot exceed 10% of salary ({{limit}}) where the employer is other than Central or State Government.
remediation: Reduce the 80CCD(2) claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: Deduction u/s 80CCD (2) should not be more than 10% of salary by an employer other than Central Government or State Government in case of Old tax regime.

message: The deduction u/s 80DDB of {{claimed}} exceeds the maximum limit of {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the 80DDB claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: If Old tax Regime is selected, and 80DDB - Resident assessee has claimed more than the maximum limit of Rs.1,00,000/-

message: A deduction u/s 80DDB has been claimed but the eligible category description has not been provided.
remediation: Select the eligible category ('Self or Dependent' or 'Senior Citizen') for the 80DDB claim.
source: If Old tax Regime is selected and Assessee is claiming deduction under section 80DDB, but eligible category description not provided

message: For the category 'Self or Dependent' the maximum deduction u/s 80DDB is {{limit}}; {{claimed}} has been claimed.
remediation: Reduce the 80DDB claim to {{limit}} or lower, or change the eligible category.

message: A deduction u/s 80G of {{claimed}} has been claimed but no details have been provided in Schedule 80G.
remediation: Add at least one donee row in Schedule 80G, or set the 80G claim to 0.
source: If Old tax Regime is selected and Deduction u/s 80G claimed but details are not provided in Schedule 80G

message: In Schedule 80G Table (F), total donations ({{total}}) must equal the sum of tables (A) + (B) + (C) + (D) ({{blocks}}).
remediation: Re-open Schedule 80G so the table totals are recomputed.

message: The deduction claimed u/s 80G ({{claimed}}) is more than the eligible amount of donation in Schedule 80G ({{eligible}}).
remediation: Reduce the 80G claim to {{eligible}} or lower.
source: If Old tax Regime is selected, then In Schedule VIA, deduction claimed u/s 80G is more than the eligible amount of donation mentioned in Schedule 80G

message: The deduction u/s 80TTA of {{claimed}} exceeds the maximum limit of {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the 80TTA claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: If Old Tax Regime is selected, then Assessee can claim deduction under section 80TTA to the maximum limit of Rs.10,000/-

message: The deduction u/s 80TTA ({{claimed}}) is restricted to the savings-account interest reported under Income from Other Sources ({{savings}}).
remediation: Reduce the 80TTA claim to {{savings}} or report the savings-account interest under Other Sources.
source: If Old Tax Regime is selected, then Deduction u/s 80TTA is restricted to the savings account interest income from other sources.

message: A deduction u/s 80TTA cannot be claimed by a senior citizen (date of birth on or before {{cutoff}}). {{claimed}} has been claimed.
remediation: Set the 80TTA claim to 0. A senior citizen should claim u/s 80TTB instead.
source: Deduction u/s 80TTA cannot be claimed by Senior Citizen (date of birth is on or Before 01.04.1966

message: The deduction u/s 80TTB of {{claimed}} exceeds the maximum limit of {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the 80TTB claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: If Old tax Regime is selected, then Assessee can claim deduction under section 80TTB to the maximum limit of Rs.50,000/-

remediation: Set the 80TTB claim to 0. Interest on a savings account may be claimed u/s 80TTA instead.

message: The deduction u/s 80TTB ({{claimed}}) is restricted to interest income reported under Other Sources ({{interest}}).
remediation: Reduce the 80TTB claim to {{interest}} or report the interest income under Other Sources.
source: If Old tax Regime is selected, and Assessee being senior citizen and claiming deduction under section 80TTB on other than interest income from other source

message: The total of Chapter VI-A deductions ({{total}}) does not match the sum of the individual eligible deductions restricted to Gross Total Income ({{expected}}).

message: Deductions claimed under Chapter VI-A ({{total}}) cannot exceed Gross Total Income ({{gti}}).
remediation: Reduce the Chapter VI-A claims to {{gti}} or lower.
source: Deductions claimed under Chapter VI-A is should not be more than "Gross Total Income"

message: The name of the taxpayer must appear exactly as in the PAN database. The surname is mandatory and is verified against the PAN database at the time of upload.
remediation: Enter the name exactly as printed on the PAN card. A mismatch will be rejected by the portal at upload.
source: ITR-1 -"Name" of taxpayer in ITR does not match with the "Name" as per the PAN data base (This will be verified at the time of upload. To ensure that the name entered is as appearing in the PAN card)
note: The PAN database is not reachable from a preparation utility. Only presence is asserted here; the UI shows a permanent warning banner. See docs/AMBIGUOUS_RULES.md.

message: Gross Total Income must be more than zero where a tax liability has been computed and paid. Gross Total Income is {{gti}} and tax paid is {{paid}}.
remediation: Enter the income under the relevant heads, or remove the taxes paid.
source: In the return filed "Gross Total Income" and all the heads of income is entered should be more than zero if tax liability has been computed and paid

message: Income details and the tax computation must be disclosed where details of taxes paid ({{paid}}) have been disclosed.
remediation: Enter the income details on the Gross Total Income screen.
source: "Income details" and "Tax computation" should be disclosed where details regarding "Taxes Paid" have been disclosed.

message: Gross Total Income ({{gti}}) must equal the total of income from Salary, House Property, Other Sources and long-term capital gains u/s 112A ({{expected}}).
remediation: Re-open the Gross Total Income screen so the total is recomputed.
source: If Old Tax Regime is selected and Gross Total Income is not equal to the Total of Incomes from Salary, House Property & Other Sources & Long-term capital gains as per sec 112A.

remediation: The rebate is not available at this income level. Verify the total income figure.

remediation: Re-open the Tax Liability screen so the total income is recomputed.

message: D3 Tax payable after rebate ({{d3}}) must equal D1 Tax payable on total income ({{d1}}) minus D2 Rebate u/s 87A ({{d2}}).
remediation: Re-open the Tax Liability screen so the figures are recomputed.
source: The amount of "Tax after Rebate" should be equal to "Tax payable on total income" Minus "Rebate u/s 87A"

message: D5 Total tax and cess ({{d5}}) must equal D3 Tax after rebate ({{d3}}) plus D4 Health and Education Cess ({{d4}}).
remediation: Re-open the Tax Liability screen so the figures are recomputed.
source: The amount at "Total tax and Cess" should be equal to sum of "Tax after Rebate" and "Heath & Education Cess

remediation: Re-open the Tax Liability screen so the figures are recomputed.

values.expected: max(0, totalTaxAndCess + interest234A + interest234B + interest234C + fee234I + fee234F - relief89)

source: "Total Tax, Fees & Interest" should be equal to the sum of "Total Tax & Cess + Interest u/s 234A + 234B+ 234C + Fees u/s 234-I + 234F- Relief u/s 89"

assert: totalInterestAndFee == interest234A + interest234B + interest234C + fee234F + fee234I
message: Total interest and fee payable ({{total}}) must equal 234A + 234B + 234C + 234F + 234-I ({{expected}}).
remediation: Re-open the Tax Liability screen so the figures are recomputed.
source: In "Schedule Income Details" Total Interest, Fee Payable should be equal to the sum of Interest u/s 234 A+ Interest u/s 234 B+ Interest u/s 234 C+ Fee u/s 234F + Fees u/s 234-I

message: Agricultural income shown as exempt ({{agri}}) cannot be more than {{limit}}. ITR-1 cannot be used where agricultural income exceeds this limit.

message: Total exempt income ({{total}}) must equal the sum of the individual exempt-income rows ({{expected}}).
remediation: Re-open the exempt income schedule so the total is recomputed.
source: In "schedule "Income Details" Exempt income should be equal to sum of amount entered in individual col. Of exempt income.

remediation: Re-open the House Property section so the 30% deduction is recomputed.
source: Standard deduction allowed on House property should be equal to 30% of Annual value.

message: For a self-occupied property under the old regime, the interest on borrowed capital cannot exceed {{limit}}. {{claimed}} has been claimed.

source: In case of "Old Tax Regime"- Deduction u/s 57(iia) cannot be more than lower of 1/3rd of Family pension or Rs. 15,000. Note: Rounding off +1 and -1.

message: The entertainment allowance u/s 16(ii) is allowed to the extent of {{limit}} — the lower of {{flat}} and one-fifth of salary ({{fifth}}). {{claimed}} has been claimed.

remediation: Reduce the 10(7) exemption to {{limit}} or lower.

remediation: Reduce the 10(10) exemption to {{limit}} or lower.
